source_findings: Installed1.4 supports contact-normal spin resistance via friction_torsional (length units) and tangent-axis rolling resistance via friction_rolling. Existing comparisons disable both. Nonzero library defaults are not measured pad properties. Spatially localized patch moments would be a distinct untested physical hypothesis, not a visual texture.
decision: No new treatment executed or selected from this source inspection. Resolve current contact-location and release mismatch first.
